name: Ketoconazole
description: Azole antifungal used on the skin and scalp as a shampoo or cream

note.text: A 2020 review found five small human studies and two mouse studies, and called for randomized controlled trials.

bullets: **Impairs ergosterol synthesis,** a fungal membrane part, in lab studies
**Seborrheic dermatitis:** label links effect to fewer M. ovale, unconfirmed
**Mouse studies** found more hair regrowth than in untreated mice
**For hair loss in people,** the mechanism is not established
Approved shampoos and cream for fungal skin

practical.halfLife: Not established for scalp use; not found in plasma
practical.routes: On the skin and scalp (shampoo, cream); tablets restricted
practical.pharmacokinetics: Not detected in plasma after months of shampooing
practical.soldAs: OTC 1% shampoo (Nizoral); Rx 2% shampoo and cream
practical.monitored: Hair density, hair diameter, scalp oil (studies)

regulatory.text: Approved for fungal skin and dandruff; not hair
Oral antifungal use suspended 2013; topical kept

references: Fields et al., Dermatol Ther, topical ketoconazole for hair loss (review), Jan 2020
